Final FLT3 call plot previews

Fragment recheck report

Histograms and curves retain their observed read/GMM meanings. The final-call panels show only the calls surviving the displayed reporting threshold, one row per sequence. Full allele position is WT reference length (336 bp) plus insertion size; insertion plots show inserted bases relative to WT (0 bp). Markers are sequence calls, not fitted Gaussian peaks or extra histogram counts.

These previews reuse the retained original GMM fit before denoising and the final saved competitive validation. No GMM fitting, denoising or read alignment was repeated. Production plots use the pipeline's current GMM/refined candidate tables plus these same final-call panels. The two 45 bp sequences differ at one junction base; separate biological clones are not established. The 0.1% preview includes both alternatives; the 0.5% preview applies the original review reporting threshold. The caller default remains 5%.
